spec_match.rationale: Polls navigator.getGamepads() from gamepadconnected in a rAF loop per the spec's Best Practice 1, and reads the exact proposed surface (GamepadButton.prototype.type gated on the documented 'type' in prototype probe) with the exact three-value enum vocabulary.

interactive.rationale: Re-scan and pause/resume controls invoke the real API; per-button cells render live value meters, pressed/touched pills, and the type pill; no static cards.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises gamepadconnected + rAF polling with value/pressed/touched and type-when-flagged; the page does exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers missing getGamepads, no-pad-connected (honest empty readout, never sample data), flag-off type column, gamepaddisconnected cleanup, and hidden-tab polling pause.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776 plus the spec PR enum anchor.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts the documented prototype probe, readonly-accessor descriptor, enum vocabulary over connected pads, and records the hardware-gated trackpad contract as kind manual; all executable assertions fail honestly on flag-off browsers.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium (Playwright-driven, both viewports) verified the no-gamepad and flag-absent paths, honest statuses, pause/resume aria-pressed, keyboard rescan, zero non-environmental console/network failures; the real-gamepad and flag-on paths are unverifiable in this sandbox (no hardware, CL 7760763 not landed) and remain untested.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts inspector-live on real detection and inspector-no-gamepad-honest / inspector-no-gamepad-api-honest separately for fallbacks — a fallback is never reported as the success assert.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables; pill/type-pill backgrounds pair explicit color (blue/ivory 7.6:1, emerald/black 5.1:1, muted/ivory 5.6:1 — all AA).

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with aria-pressed, aria-live=polite outputs updated only on state change (no per-frame screen-reader spam), value meters exposed via aria-label, visible focus outlines; keyboard activation verified.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at true 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow, all buttons >=44px, full-width controls under 640px; button grid uses auto-fill minmax with min-width:0.

openQuestions.title: Verify the real flag-on gamepad path once Chromium CL 7760763 lands
openQuestions.detail: The sandbox has no physical gamepad and the implementation is still in review, so the type pill's real-output branch (type: "standard"/"non-standard"/"trackpad" per button) has only been code-reviewed, never observed. Once the CL lands, run Canary with --enable-blink-features=GamepadButtonTypes and a DualSense, confirm the touchpad click's pill reads "trackpad", and update this critique plus the manual conformance assertion's observed status.

openQuestions.title: chrome-devtools-mcp verification pass still owed
openQuestions.detail: Per CLAUDE.md rule 7b this build was verified with headless Chromium driven via Playwright CDP (the only tool available in this environment, as the build brief directs); a chrome-devtools-mcp session should re-verify controls and the accessibility tree in a local session.

guidanceConsulted.query: high frequency live readout requestAnimationFrame polling accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native controls with accessible names, live regions for state changes, no per-frame announcement spam.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native buttons with labels and aria-pressed; status readouts are <output aria-live="polite"> updated only when the pressed-set actually changes, not every animation frame.

guidanceConsulted.query: pause high-frequency polling when content not visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pause heavy background loops (canvas/polling) when the content is not being rendered.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The rAF polling loop cancels on visibilitychange-hidden, when no gamepad is connected, and via an explicit user pause control, resuming on visibility/reconnect.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of status cards without horizontal overflow narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fill minmax grids with min-width:0 and wrap-anywhere text instead of fixed columns.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button-state grid is repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr)) (130px under 640px) with min-width:0 cells and overflow-wrap:anywhere on ids/status; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Live inspector for GamepadButton state including the flagged type attribute. Fallback paths (no API, no pad, flag off, disconnect, hidden tab) are all honest and were browser-verified headlessly on desktop+mobile viewports with clean console/network (except the environmental fonts.googleapis failure); the flag-on hardware path is honestly untestable in this sandbox and is tracked as an open question.
